name: VirtualList
usage: Message lists, long conversation lists, search results

props.name: getKey
props.description: Stable key of a row (such as the message ID).

props.name: estimateSize
props.description: Estimated row height in pixels, 48 by default.

props.name: overscan
props.description: Number of extra rows rendered outside the visible area (overscan), 6 by default.

props.name: onReachStart
props.description: Called when scrolled near the top (to load earlier data).

props.name: onReachEnd
props.description: Called when scrolled near the bottom.

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown when there are no items.

props.name: testId
props.description: Test id, rendered as `data-testid` on the scrolling element.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
Of two thousand rows, only the visible part is rendered; the height comes from the parent element (in a real
page, put it in `Page fill` / `Panel fill`).
